chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, and Muhammad ibn Ismail, from Al-Fadl ibn Shazan, from Ibn Abi Umayr, and Safwan ibn Yahya, from Muawiya ibn Ammar, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:

Abdullah (peace be upon him) said: 'From the perfection of the Hajj and the Umrah is that you enter into Ihram from the Mawaqit (stations) which the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) designated, and you do not pass them except while you are in Ihram. For he designated for the people of Iraq, and at that time there was no Iraq, Batn Al-Aqiq from the direction of the people of Iraq; and he designated for the people of Yemen, Yalamlam; and he designated for the people of Al-Taif, Qarn Al-Manazil; and he designated for the people of Al-Maghrib (the West), Al-Juhfa, and it is Mahya; and he designated for the people of Al-Madinah, Dhu Al-Hulayfah. And whoever's dwelling is behind these Mawaqit, from what faces Mecca, then his Mawqit is his dwelling.'

key_terms.إِحْرَام: State of consecration for Hajj or Umrah
key_terms.الْجُحْفَةَ: The designated station for the people of Al-Maghrib (West)
key_terms.الْمَوَاقِيتِ: Stations or boundaries for entering Ihram
key_terms.بَطْنَ الْعَقِيقِ: A specific location designated for the people of Iraq
key_terms.ذُو الْحُلَيْفَةِ: The designated station for the people of Al-Madinah
key_terms.قَرْنَ الْمَنَازِلِ: The designated station for the people of Al-Taif
key_terms.يَلَمْلَمَ: The designated station for the people of Yemen

ai.seo_question: What are the designated Mawaqit for entering Ihram in Shia jurisprudence?
ai.summary: This hadith from Al-Kafi establishes the Mawaqit as the canonical boundaries for entering the state of Ihram, emphasizing the Prophet's (saww) authority in designating these stations for various regions like Iraq, Yemen, and Medina. It clarifies the legal principle that those residing beyond these designated points must assume Ihram from their own homes, ensuring uniformity in the ritual commencement of Hajj and Umrah.
